kinematics.status: engineering interpretation of inspected official imagery, not manufacturer-certified dynamics

drivetrain.description: Two independently driven standard wheels, two passive omni wheels; differential-drive forward/reverse and yaw, no direct lateral drive

arm.description: One shared arm elevation pivot driven by 12T pinion meshing with 84T gear; paired arm channels are coupled, not independent
arm.external_reduction: 7:1 derived from documented tooth counts; motor cartridge not specified by manual

claw.description: Single motor drives coupled two-sided open/close mechanism; no independent finger or wrist motor documented

kinematics.pickup_evidence: Official remix lesson demonstrates grabbing/releasing classroom objects one at a time; does not publish mass, width, friction, or allowable center-of-mass limits. Do not infer those from pictures.

dimensions.manual_documented: Nominal 4 inch wheels; screw and spacer lengths, shaft pitch labels, channel hole-count designations, 1/8 inch gear bore and 1/2 inch adapter length appear explicitly in parts list.

mount_grid.evidence_level: official product page indexed search excerpt; direct reader HTTP 403; generic metal specification, not a measured or tolerance-verified statement for each Clawbot member

dimensions.scale_warning: Page 2 says V5 control system, gears, wheels, wires and structure are not to scale; other parts listed 1:1. PDF display/print scaling is not an engineering dimension source.

controls.programming_environment: VEXcode V5; official Clawbot Controller with Events example preconfigures motors/sensors

controller.drive: Tank input, left and right joystick vertical positions 3 and 2 respectively; independent velocities
controller.arm: L1/L2 up/down; L1 up explicitly demonstrated
controller.claw: R1/R2 open/close pair; exact direction per individual R button not stated in retrieved prose
controller.release: Example stops arm/claw when corresponding buttons are not held; teacher answer predicts holding position

controls.source_caveat: Tank Drive page image alt text includes an inconsistent note about right left/right axis, while displayed block descriptions and teacher prose use independent motor values on axes 3 and 2 and up/down joystick motion. Preserve tank interpretation, not arcade mixing.
controls.simulation: No revision-matched official V5 Clawbot simulator or dynamics model verified. VEXcode VR competition playgrounds use other robots and cannot certify this assembly. Any application controls/physics must be labeled application modeling choices.
